_note: Omni-MM ReAct with Gemini: BOTH reasoners use gemini-3.1-flash-lite because _build_multimodal_observation() attaches actual media files to every intermediate SEARCH observation. api_format='gemini' sends video as image_url (Gemini treats all media as inline_data).

rewrite_reasoner._comment: Cheap text LLM for query rewriting. VL models don't handle keyword extraction well, so use a text model here.

react._note: Primary adaptive mode receives the original question and embeds agent tool queries unchanged. query_policy/query_manifest are used only by one_search_parity.

react_reasoner._comment: Gemini VL model for ReAct loop — sees images/audio/video in each SEARCH observation.
react_reasoner._api_format_note: Gemini treats all media as inline_data — image_url works for images, video, and audio.

answer_reasoner._comment: Same Gemini VL model for the final answer with all accumulated media.
answer_reasoner._api_format_note: Gemini treats all media as inline_data — image_url works for images, video, and audio.
